0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East) in Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play, with Washington on a one-game losing streak and Atlanta on a two-game winning streak. Washington trails the season series 0-1 after losing 120-105 in Washington on November 4, and it lost the 2025-26 series 1-3. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision; Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision.
